rival_reading: The lap-time notation and key tally may be unrelated records of ordinary local work; nothing here proves an evacuation or containment failure.
gloss: A map annotation sits beside a completed key return and an unfinished route entry.
title: Return count complete, route line empty
body: The location copy preserves 56.34 seconds beside an empty route line. A child's drawing is folded under the key tag; the only complete return count is for keys.

rival_reading: Emergency crews could tally field water after a diversion; an incomplete route entry does not establish an agricultural malfunction.
gloss: A field-water line predates a route entry beside a recorded interval.
title: Water total entered before the route line
body: The map annotation keeps 1 minute, 14.55 seconds. The notebook's field-water line predates the route entry; a child's drink reminder is taped to the bottle, but only the bottle count is complete.

rival_reading: A route acknowledgment may be ordinary local scheduling after access changed; the late entry and returned page do not prove a failed containment order.
gloss: A dispatch acknowledgment follows a road restriction while the recipient field remains incomplete.
title: Acknowledgment follows the restriction
body: The route acknowledgment is entered after the road restriction. The note still copies 56.34 seconds; a child's drawing is on the return copy, and the completed field counts pages sent, not recipients.

rival_reading: The timing may be ordinary field planning, while the road restriction reflects later emergency action; a water tally alone cannot tell which came first.
gloss: A dated field measure and a copied interval remain beside an incomplete origin record.
title: Field record signed after the round
body: The receipt's field measure is dated before the route round was closed. The map beside it keeps 1 minute, 14.55 seconds. A child's lunch reminder survives; only the container count is signed.
